system.description:
The jungle archers of Komodo Isle and the Jinia forests, who make their arrows from the beasts they hunt.

  • Rare Arrows: your Arrow Repertoire adds two arrows made from rare beasts. Venom arrow: +1d6 poison, and the target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Barbed arrow: the target makes a Reflex save or its speed is halved until it spends an action to pull the barb free.
    • 9th level: venom arrows deal +2d6 poison.
  • Island Craft: Advantage on Fletcher's Craft checks with improvised or natural materials instead of proper tools.
